body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. We imported the nine-punch job. The control resolved nine ISO resources and threading points. The plot had 72 cutting blocks and separate cutting envelopes. The editor also exposed different resident quality values under the original quality names. See #2999 for the corrected import behavior.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

Port onto the current frame. The new head is `13c980658`.

- Merge of `1e12c77a4` (#2981). The conflicts were in `posting_agie.rs`, `agie/mod.rs`, `agie/tests.rs`, the user guide and `crates/app/tests/agie_group.rs`. The frame side was taken in each file. The PR's change was then applied again on the frame in a new commit.
- The punch group limit is now 9 (`MAX_PUNCH_WORKS`) in the setup writer, the post and the app. Die groups stay at two openings.
- One `CCB030` quality object for all works (#2984). The per-work quality objects of the old body were not kept.
- The clear-band check covers every pair of works and names the two works.
- New goldens: `TRIO20.SBL/SBR`, `NINE20.SBL/SBR`, `TRIO201..203.ISO`. The PAIR20, DUODI20 and other existing goldens did not change.
- A new control import of TRIO20 and NINE20 on the emulated control: `CCB030[4]` on each work after TECCUT, `geen fouten`, 24 and 72 cut blocks, head-up transits only, and no overlap of the cutting envelopes. The PR body has the table.
- Gate: batch fallback, 1192 of 1193 steps ok, clippy ok. The one red step is the known #3774 test `rotary_verify`.
This PR goes back to draft. It takes the fixed head of #2981 and moves its test changes into the existing suites. The PR is flagged ready again when the gate is green.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 13c98065810173c6da65264cfa6799df470d5cd6 -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review of the complete trial merge with upstream main `9046e1dc80d266f7dcc1ed04acd052e874bac81a`. The trial merge is `78428311c4601a9f80b2da642f7e95e850f5e85b`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. There is no earlier collaborator review to resolve.

The group checks every pair of works before publication. The count limit, separate resources, shared quality, and refusal of unowned models have passing tests.

**Results, run locally**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: batch fallback; 1,204 steps passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This includes the debug builds and clippy with `-D warnings`.
- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed. UI lib: 1,587 passed, 8 ignored. The new cutoff Apply/Undo test passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: all 11 light twins passed; 6 steps passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- Full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream AGENTS.md requires no full heavy lane for this P6 PR.

**Extra suites run**

These readers ran again after quick because the diff adds golden files.

| Suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| camcraft-post lib | 146 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_cutoff_setup | 4 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_die_group_setup | 5 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_group_setup | 5 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_safe_setup | 8 | 0 |
| camcraft-app agie_native | 30 | 0 |
| camcraft-app agie_quality | 3 | 0 |

**Input mutations repeated in this review**

I ran separate temporary CLI cases. The valid trio and nine-work controls passed and wrote 5 and 11 files.

1. Put work 3 on work 1, with work 2 clear. The CLI failed as expected and named `TRIO201` and `TRIO203`. No output directory appeared.
2. Add a tenth work to the grid. The CLI failed as expected with the `2 to 9` diagnostic. No output directory appeared.

Both refusal assertions passed. These were input mutations; the source files were not edited.

**Goldens checked**

I read all 19 added golden files line by line. I checked the ISO coordinates, arc centres, work names, resources, holes, shared quality, and zero-step setup.

- App: `CIRCLE20.ISO`, `DUODI201.ISO`, `DUODI202.ISO`, `FINE20.ISO/SBL/SBR`, `RACE20.ISO`, and `TRIO201..203.ISO`.
- Post: `DUODI20.SBL/SBR`, `LOWER20.SBL`, `NINE20.SBL/SBR`, `PAIR20.SBL/SBR`, and `TRIO20.SBL/SBR`.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/app/src/operation/agie_die.rs:13`: Move the geometric opening match into camcraft-geometry. Keep the document selection lookup in app. This new module only compares loops, areas, bounds, and region differences after it reads `GenJob.contour_sel`. It does not read the ECS world, project file, command, MCP, or CLI. Current AGENTS.md requires this domain code in its owning crate.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:235`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the two new cutoff controls. The body has no screenshot links. Keep the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
3. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`: Add `Process change: yes` to the PR body. This diff changes a process file. Do not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; the merging session owns that change.
4. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/CIRCLE20.ISO:1`: Add a complete `Goldens moved` list to the PR body. List the 19 additions relative to upstream main, including the inherited stack changes. The current body only lists the new trio/grid files and calls the parent goldens unchanged.
5. `crates/app/tests/agie_quality.rs:1`: Give the required reason for each new top-level test binary, or put its tests in an existing suite. This also applies to `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs`, `agie_die_group_setup.rs`, and `agie_group_setup.rs`. None is in ISOLATED or SLOW_BINARIES. The PR body gives no reason for these four binaries.

**Optional, non-blocking**

The diff grows two source files already above 400 lines: `mcp/job.rs` from 404 to 406, and `operation/wire_op.rs` from 494 to 496.

No controller run or physical cut was made in this review. The controller readings are the author's evidence.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
